title: Adaptive fallback registry: tokenizer consistency runbook and tooling updates
creator: Sofia Nguyen
description: Background: Smart routing can fail in subtle ways when a primary model and its fallback variants do not preserve tokenizer behavior or KV cache context invariants. We've observed two classes of production incidents: 1) tokenization drift leading to token mismatches across variants and broken deterministic prompts, and 2) KV/context boundary mismatches that cause hallucinations or state leakage when a request is routed to a fallback. Scope: create and operate an "adaptive fallback registry" that catalogs variant compatibility metadata (tokenizer fingerprint, max context behavior, tooling adapters required), a runbook for remediation, and CI/telemetry to catch regressions before routing rollouts. This ticket covers the registry schema, ingestion tooling, CI gates, routing guard integration, and documentation for on-call and launch engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Registry schema defined and committed in infra repo with versioning
Automated tokenizer fingerprint generator implemented and runnable in CI
Routing service consults registry and refuses unsafe fallbacks by default
Nightly compatibility sweep runs and reports failures to #infra-ai-compat
Runbook and playbook published and linked in Console docs
Observed tokenizer_mismatch_rate < 0.05% on canary traffic after rollout
tasks: Design registry JSON/YAML schema and add examples
Implement tokenizer fingerprint CLI and Docker image
Add KV context invariants checklist and small binary probe tool
Wire registry lookup into smart-router decision path with fast cache
Create CI job: compatibility-sweep that cross-checks live model variants
Add routing unit tests and an e2e harness for a small sample prompt set
Write runbook: detection, mitigation, rollback, notification templates
Update Console UI doc for model variant compatibility view
implementation_notes: Tokenizer fingerprint approach: normalize tokenizer config and compute SHA256 of serialized tokenization table + version
KV context probe: replay short prefix sequences and compare decoded tokens/length and KV cache hit shapes
Routing integration: add a pre-route check that queries the registry; cache responses in router-local LRU with TTL 5m
Performance: registry lookup must add <0.5ms median to routing path. Add local cache to avoid high p95 latency
Backward compatibility: absent registry entries should be treated as unknown -> opt-out from automatic fallback until certified
Owner: Runtime infra team for tooling, Router team for integration, DX for docs
telemetry: metric: tokenizer_mismatch_rate (percent of requests where tokenizer outputs differ between primary and fallback)
metric: kv_context_replay_failures (count of failed KV invariant checks during sweep)
alert: tokenizer_mismatch_rate > 0.5% sustained for 15m -> P0 incident
rollback_plan: If mismatch rate spikes after rollout, immediately disable automatic fallback routing via runtime flag: router.fallback.enabled=false
Pin affected customer routes to previous model version using routing overrides in Console
Re-run compatibility sweep and identify offending variant; mark as quarantine in registry
Hotfix: add a tokenizer adapter shim that normalizes tokenization for the short term
Follow-up: revoke rollout and schedule full remediation sprint
test_plan: Unit tests for tokenizer fingerprint generator against seeded tokenizers
Integration test: router consults registry and rejects unsafe fallback (simulate 3 variant pairs)
E2E: sample prompt set (100 prompts) run through primary and fallback to assert identical token stream or acceptable tolerance
Fuzzing: random prefix sequences to detect KV context divergence
CI gating: compatibility-sweep must pass for target variant set before canary rollout job proceeds
